data.title: 五和 · 冬日公园长椅上的热茶斟注
data.description: 学园都市被初雪覆盖的街心公园长椅旁，五和双手握着保温壶，小心翼翼地把刚泡好的热红茶倾入杯盖递向身边的你，白雾轻拂脸颊，目光满是纯澈的依恋。
data.location: snowy city park bench beside bare winter trees under gentle overcast afternoon light
data.action: pouring steaming hot tea from stainless thermos into cup lid, looking over with caring tender purple eyes and a faint blush
data.lighting: 冬日雪地漫射天光与茶水升腾白雾
data.promptProse: Itsuwa carefully pours steaming tea from a thermos into the cup cap on a snowy park bench, offering it with gentle, loving purple eyes.
data.animaCaption: Warm tea vapor curls upward in the cold winter air as she presents the cup with caring eyes.
